"andrew garfield brings a sincere, wounded quality to eduardo saverin, zuckerberg’s former best friend and early business partner. garfield’s performance highlights the emotional toll of betrayal and the yearning for loyalty in a world driven by ambition. justin timberlake’s sean parker slips in as the charismatic, reckless mentor who introduces the protagonist to the lure of silicon valley fame, while rooney mara’s erica albright provides the grounding human contrast that reminds zuckerberg of what he is sacrificing. the supporting cast, including armie hammer as the winklevoss twins and rashida jones as the diligent lawyer, adds depth to the courtroom drama that frames much of the narrative."
